_meta.note: A site feature is a UniProt Active site, Binding site, Site, Metal binding, DNA binding, Nucleotide binding or Zinc finger feature that contains a residue of the predicted pocket, read through the entry's own numbering (PDBe SIFTS). No feature means none is annotated, not that nothing is known. A row whose entry could not be mapped (x) was not checked, so it is unknown, not clear. Engineered changes are the entry's own SEQADV records at pocket residues.
